about: Conformance cases for literals, records, let, conditionals, arithmetic, the math builtins, lists (consumed, built and written to the output), nil narrowing and variants. Each runs on Go expr (oracle/) and on our compiler + VM; results must agree (spec §9). Every program here must be accepted by both. A schema written {"$name": true} stands for defs.name. A case's `builtins` lists the test builtins it calls (spec §9).
